messages:
marta: Quick spotcheck — the Runtime API doc has an example that still references model version v0.9 and the curl snippet shows /models/redwood-v0.9. Not sure who owns that page, found it during a link sweep :eyes:

sam: docs-bot flagged it last night as 'deprecated-model-reference' and a possible broken example link, pinging @docs for an owner.

docs-bot: Automated scan: flagged 'docs/runtime/api.md' (line ~132) — occurrence: "redwood-v0.9". Also noticed example-app link (https://github.com/redwood/example-app) may 404 for the old branch. Please assign owner.

anya: I can take the page. Is there a canonical replacement string we should use? v1.2 or something else?

kevin: Confirm replacement should be "redwood-1.2-rr". Also update the example client in github.com/redwood/example-app (branch: docs-fix/model-ref). If possible add a one-line deprecation note: "v0.9 deprecated — use redwood-1.2-rr or contact infra".

marta: If you update, please add a one-line changelog at the top and ping @lina for i18n sweep. Also run the local link-check: `scripts/link-check.sh docs/runtime/api.md` before PR.

anya: On it. Quick Q: the snippet uses curl with a JSON body — should I add the new "model_variant" param as well? The runtime spec mentions it now.

kevin: Yes please — include `\"model_variant\": \"high-throughput\"` in the example and a short comment about tradeoffs (latency vs cost).

docs-bot: Deploy checklist reminder: update frontmatter `last_edited_by`, create PR titled: "docs: bump model ref and example variant", and run `ci/docs`.

lina: I'll handle localization strings after the PR merges — ping me in #i18n once it's merged so I can queue translation updates.

marta: Great — assigning to anya. Thanks all :thumbsup:

anya: Starting a branch now: `docs/2469999999-model-ref-fix` — will open a draft PR when the snippet + changelog are ready.
